text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe brilliantly conquers the 
Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The immense strain taken on by her body... 
The Trainer provides dedicated care 
alongside Agnes Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it turned out to be nothing 
serious, keeping hopes alive for the 
autumn races.
